data.name: Arcane Spellforge: Core Defense
data.detailed_description:
Arcane Spellforge: Core Defense is a VR action-strategy game where you forge spells with your hands and defend a critical core against relentless waves of robotic enemies. Step into the Spellforge, craft modular weapons, upgrade spells, and strategically build towers to survive intense combat.

Core Gameplay

  • Hand-Crafted Spellcasting: Draw, combine, and upgrade spells on a VR grid with intuitive hand gestures.

  • Wave-Based Combat: Face endless robotic enemies using a mix of spells and modular firearms.

  • Defense Building: Place towers and barriers while actively fighting to protect the core.

  • Resource Management: Collect resources from combat to enhance weapons, towers, and core.

  • Modular Weapons: Customize your arsenal for different combat strategies and spell synergies.

VR Immersion

  • Full hand-tracking and spatial interaction

  • Intuitive spellcrafting mechanics

  • Real-time integration of spell creation and tower defense

Combine strategy, reflexes, and creativity to survive the escalating challenges of the Arcane Spellforge. Build, cast, and defend in this unique VR experience.

data.short_description: Forge spells with your hands, build tactical defenses, and unleash devastating power in VR. Upgrade modular weapons and towers, adapt your strategy, and survive relentless waves of robotic enemies attacking your core from every direction.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: SteamVR Supported headsets: Valve Index, HTC Vive, Oculus Rift / Rift S, Quest (Link / Air Link), Pimax (Basic Support)
  • Additional Notes: Minimum specs target low–medium settings at stable 72–80 FPS in VR.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: OS Version: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: SteamVR Supported headsets: Valve Index, HTC Vive Pro, Meta Quest 2/3 (Link / Air Link), Pimax (Native Support)
  • Additional Notes: Recommended specs target high settings, stable 90–120 FPS, and advanced visual effects.
